intent: Write an earlier misunderstanding, preserve the known younger-sister reason and acknowledge asking before guessing, accepting coherent needed-to/had-to structures.
picturePurpose: Reuse the owner-original departure/meeting scenes to distinguish visible action from an earlier belief before repairing the written past form; exact grammar and evidence labels remain coded. The art supplies neither motive nor relationship.

workshop.title: 让文字分清误会与事实
workshop.instruction: 先标明原来只是自己的想法，再说明后来知道的原因，最后承认应先问。比较两种自然写法，完成自己的2—4句英文。

items.label: I thought后写原先的想法
items.prompt: 先看图示中的离开动作，再修复描述过去误会的句子。哪句没有把猜测继续当成事实？
items.reason: 误会的时间和证据范围已核对。接下来补上后来知道的原因。
items.hint: 这张卡练习过去的想法：I thought you were ...。也可以用其他自然句式描述合理的误会，不要求真的发生过生气。
items.material: 写2—4句英文。朋友突然离开游戏，你后来知道他要接妹妹。向他说明原来的误会，并承认应先询问。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。

composeBrief.title: 过去想法修复台
composeBrief.hint: thought后保留完整句子；was/were要与主语对应。
composeBrief.wrong: 这里描述过去的想法，you对应were，不用was或be原形。I thought标记原先的误会，不能换成已经证实朋友讨厌自己。

fields.label: 修复 I thought you was angry with me.

choices.label: I thought you were angry with me.
I thought you was angry with me.
I thought you be angry with me.
My earlier thought, which turned out to be a misunderstanding.
A proven fact that my friend dislikes me.
My friend’s future plan to leave every game.

composeArt.alt: 虚构情境示例：左图一名男生离开桌上游戏，两位朋友留在桌旁；右图同一男生与一位较小的学生在校门附近见面。
composeArt.caption: 复用虚构示例：画面只显示离开与见面。生气是原先误会的一个例子；妹妹关系及接她的原因来自题目文字，不能从表情或衣服推断。

items.label: 同一个事实，可以换自然句式
items.prompt: 选一种写法，再把接妹妹的原因写对。
items.reason: 所选结构与真实原因已配好。自己的稿子也可以用其他准确说法。
items.hint: needed to后用动词原形pick；had to后也用动词原形pick。两种写法都能表达当时要接妹妹，不把妹妹换成哥哥。
items.material: 写2—4句英文。朋友突然离开游戏，你后来知道他要接妹妹。向他说明原来的误会，并承认应先询问。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。

composeBrief.title: needed to ↔ had to
composeBrief.hint: 句式可换，后来知道的接妹妹原因不换。
composeBrief.wrong: 两个正确示例都可用，但要与所选结构一致。needed to和had to后都用pick，不用picked；后来知道的原因是接妹妹，不是接哥哥，也不是继续猜测朋友的情绪。

choices.label: Now I know you needed to ...
Now I understand that you had to ...

fields.label: 哪句与所选结构及原因一致？

choices.label: Now I know you needed to pick up your younger sister.
Now I understand that you had to pick up your younger sister.
Now I know you needed to picked up your older brother.

items.label: 把反思落到自己可以改变的沟通
items.prompt: 哪句承认当时应先询问？写作任务要交什么？
items.reason: 过去反思与写作形式已核对。逐句检查自己的2—4句英文，保留原先误会、真实原因与反思。
items.hint: should have后用过去分词asked。它是本卡的过去反思示例，不是整篇唯一可用的表达。不要只责怪朋友，或只抄sister一个词。
items.material: 写2—4句英文。朋友突然离开游戏，你后来知道他要接妹妹。向他说明原来的误会，并承认应先询问。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。

composeBrief.title: 反思与交稿核对卡
composeBrief.hint: 检查动词形式，也检查是否覆盖三个信息层次。
composeBrief.wrong: should have后用过去分词asked，不用ask，表达当时本该先问。本题要写2—4句英文，只交口头提纲或两个单词都不够；不能继续把未经证实的讨厌动机当事实。

fields.label: 哪句正确表达过去反思？

choices.label: I should have asked you first instead of guessing.
I should have ask you first instead of guessing.
It was all your fault, so I did not need to ask.
Two to four written English sentences covering the misunderstanding, real reason and reflection.
Only a spoken plan, without a written response.
Only the words game and sister.

transfer.stem: 朋友突然离开拍照活动，你后来知道他要把借来的相机送到美术老师那里。哪段回答更新了事实，并反思了自己的沟通？
transfer.passage:
A different misunderstanding
A friend suddenly left your group’s photo activity. You later learned that they had to deliver a borrowed camera to the art teacher. Write two to four English sentences explaining your earlier misunderstanding and admitting that you should have asked before guessing. Describe a reasonable earlier misunderstanding; it is not evidence of the friend’s real motive.

options.text: You left the photo activity because you dislike our group. I know that my first guess was right. I do not need to ask you about it.
I thought you left because you were angry with me. Now I know you needed to pick up your younger sister. I should have asked you first.

I thought you left because you no longer wanted to take photographs with us. Now I understand that you had to deliver a borrowed camera to the art teacher. I should have asked you first instead of guessing.
Our group had a photo activity today. We took photographs with a borrowed camera. I enjoyed taking part in the activity with my classmates.

answer.display: I thought you left because you no longer wanted to take photographs with us. Now I understand that you had to deliver a borrowed camera to the art teacher. I should have asked you first instead of guessing.

explanation.strategy: 先区分原先想法与后来事实，再检查自己的反思和书面表达。

steps.text: 新原因是把借来的相机送到美术老师那里，不是接妹妹，也不是已证实讨厌小组。
steps.reason: 事实要根据新题更新，不能拿旧答案替换。

steps.text: 写清原先合理的误会，再承认应先问；完成2—4句英文。
steps.reason: 只有原因或关键词，还没有覆盖误会与反思。

distractors.reason: 把没有证实的讨厌动机继续当事实。
照搬旧任务的接妹妹原因。
只介绍拍照活动，没有说明原先的误会，也没有反思当时应该先问。

explanation.pitfall: 语法改对了，却仍把自己的猜测写成对方已经证实的动机。
